30456.commentary: (VINa) tikabhojanan'ti ettha tīhi janehi bhuñjitabbabhojanaṃ. (SNa) tikabhojanaṃ paññattan'ti, idaṃ gaṇabhojane aññatra samayā pācittiyan'ti (pāci. 211). idaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ. tattha hi tiṇṇaṃ janānaṃ akappiyanimantanaṃ sādiyitvā ekato paṭiggaṇhantānam'pi anāpatti, tasmā tikabhojanan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āyasmā mahākassapo etadavoca, kati nu kho, āvuso ānanda, atthavase paṭicca bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññattan'ti?

tena hi, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññapessāmi tayo atthavase paṭicca, dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalāna niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, mā pāp'icchā pakkhaṃ nissāya saṅghaṃ bhindeyyun'ti, kulānuddayāya ca. gaṇabhojane yathādhammo kāretabbo'ti.
sabbaññū sabbadassāvī, jino ācariyo mama, mahākāruṇiko satthā, sabbalokatikicchako.

tikicchakā, bhikkhave, virecanaṃ denti pittasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya, semhasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya, vātasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya. atth'etaṃ, bhikkhave, virecanaṃ, n'etaṃ n'atthī'ti vadāmi.
addasā kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ etadavoca, tikiccha maṃ devānam'indā'ti
tija gupa kita mānu icc'etehi dhātūhi kha cha sa icc'ete paccayā honti vā. titikkhati, jigucchati, tikicchati, vīmaṃsati. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? tejati, gopati, māneti.

30461.commentary: (SNa) ubhinnaṃ tikicchantānan'ti ubhinnaṃ tikicchantaṃ. ayam'eva vā pāṭho. yo puggalo sato upasammati, ubhinnam'atthaṃ carati tikicchati sādheti, taṃ puggalaṃ janā bālo'ti maññanti.

examples.text: ubhinnaṃ tikicchantānaṃ, attano ca parassa ca, janā maññanti bālo'ti, ye dhammassa akovidā'ti.

30474.commentary: (PM) tikkhapaññatāya saṃvattantī'ti katamā tikkhapaññā? khippaṃ kilese chindatī'ti, tikkhapaññā. uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ n'ādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gametī'ti, tikkhapaññā. uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ n'ādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gametī'ti, tikkhapaññā. uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ n'ādhivāseti… uppann'uppanne pāpake akusale dhamme n'ādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gametī'ti, tikkhapaññā.

30490.meaning2: leave it alone or let it be so

examples.text: tiṭṭhatha tumhe soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo mayā saddhiṃ paṭimantetū'ti
brāhmaṇo evam'āha, tiṭṭhatu nāgo, mā nāgaṃ ghaṭṭesi, namo karohi nāgassā'ti.

30491.meaning1: let that be!; enough of that!
30491.commentary: (ANa) tiṭṭhat'etan'ti tiṭṭhatu etaṃ, mā etaṃ paṭṭhapetha, ko vo etena attho.

examples.text: alaṃ, brāhmaṇā! tiṭṭhat'etaṃ, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ ñāṇavādānaṃ ubhinnaṃ aññam'aññaṃ vipaccanīkavādānaṃ ko saccaṃ āha ko musā'ti. dhammaṃ vo, brāhmaṇā, desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti.
api ca tiṭṭhat'etaṃ, idāni'pi mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāma, ko nu kho āyasmantānaṃ sukhavihāritaro rājā vā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro āyasmā vā gotamo'ti?

30492.meaning1: never mind that!; let that be!

examples.text: evaṃ vutte poṭṭhapādo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, tiṭṭhat'esā, bhante, kathā, yāya mayaṃ eta'r'ahi kathāya sannisinnā. n'esā, bhante, kathā bhagavato dullabhā bhavissati pacchā'pi savanāya.
tiṭṭhat'esā, bho gotama, amhākañ'c'eva aññesañ'ca puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vācā. vilāpaṃ vilapitaṃ maññe.

30495.commentary: (DNa) tiṭṭhantam'pi carantampī'ti ettha sakkharakathalaṃ tiṭṭhati'y'eva, itarāni caranti'pi tiṭṭhanti'pi. yathā pana antar'antarā ṭhitāsu'pi nisinnāsu'pi vijjamānāsu'pi etā gāvo carantī'ti carantiyo upādāya itarā'pi carantī'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo sabbā, abhijānaṃ tathāgato, tiṭṭhantam'enaṃ jānāti, vimuttaṃ tapparāyaṇaṃ.
majjhe sarasmiṃ tiṭṭhataṃ, oghe jāte mahabbhaye, jarāmaccuparetānaṃ, dīpaṃ pabrūhi mārisa, tvañ'ca me dīpamakkhāhi, yathā'y'idaṃ n'āparaṃ siyā.

tassa tiṭṭhant'eva pañc'indriyāni yesaṃ avighātattā manāp'āmanāpaṃ paccanubhoti, sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. tassa yo rāgakkhayo, dosakkhayo, mohakkhayo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saupādisesā nibbānadhātu.
satto guhāyaṃ bahun'ābhichanno, tiṭṭhaṃ naro mohanasmiṃ pagāḷho, dūre vivekā hi tathāvidho so, kāmā hi loke na hi suppahāyā.

30497.meaning1: never mind them!; let them be!; set aside!; let alone!

examples.text: tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhū. atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekā bhikkhunī'pi sāvikā yā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī'ti?

30498.meaning2: who stops and waits (for a donor when begging)
30498.commentary: (ANa) bhikkhāya gahaṇ'atthaṃ ehi, bhadante'ti vutto na etī'ti na ehibhadantiko. tena hi tiṭṭha, bhante'ti vutto'pi na tiṭṭhatī'ti na tiṭṭhabhadantiko.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco acelako hoti mutt'ācāro, hatth'āpalekhano hatth'āvalekhano, na ehibhadantiko, na tiṭṭhabhadantiko, n'ābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.

30499.commentary: (MNa) tena hi tiṭṭha bhaddante'ti vutto'pi na tiṭṭhatī'ti na tiṭṭhabhaddantiko.

examples.text: tatrāssu me idaṃ, sāriputta, tapassitāya hoti, acelako homi mutt'ācāro hatth'āpalekhano, na ehibhaddantiko na tiṭṭhabhaddantiko
